policy: Only explicitly identified orbital systemic solutions or a measured wide-companion proxy are adopted. A single spectroscopic component velocity, zero placeholder, minimum mass, or unrelated cluster mean cannot supply an unknown system velocity. Native wide companions remain independent. All proxies are labelled System bulk motion and keep their donor/formal-error scope.
